assessment: Presenting important findings, this study describes the development of the functional brain connectome in human fetuses and neonates through the application of a novel deep learning approach: adult trained variational autoencoder. The methodology, analyses, and evidence provided are convincing and pave the way for future studies on non-linear models of brain network maturation. This work is of potential neuroscientific and methodological interest to researchers studying functional resting-state networks and brain development, as well as to deep learning scientists.
